ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Use your location to show your position, speed and course while Veetr is open. Recording and sharing start only when you choose them.
ios.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Share your boat position during an active tracking session, including while the screen is locked.
ios.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: Share your boat position during an active tracking session, including while the screen is locked.
ios.NSMotionUsageDescription: Use motion sensors to reduce GPS speed drift when your phone is stationary.
